title: Constructible sheaf of modules on the small etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, let $T_{\Et}$ be the small etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $\Lambda_T$ its constant sheaf of rings, and let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The sheaf $\mathcal F$ is *constructible* if there is a stratification $(\iota_k\colon Z_k\to T)_{k<n}$ of the scheme $T$ [def-constructible-stratification] (a finite partition $T=\coprod_{k<n}T_k$ of the underlying space into pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets, with immersions $\iota_k$ of schemes $Z_k$ having set-theoretic image $T_k$) such that every stratum $T_k$ is a constructible subset of the underlying space of $T$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], and for every $k$ the inverse image $\iota_k^{-1}\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], a sheaf of $\Lambda_{Z_k}$-modules on $(Z_k)_{\Et}$, is finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]: there is an etale covering $\{U_i\to Z_k\}$ such that each restriction to $U_i$ is isomorphic, as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules, to a constant sheaf $\underline{M_i}$ of a $\Lambda$-module $M_i$, and its stalk at every geometric point of $Z_k$ is a finite set.

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma Tag 095E, condition (3) (label lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), the form for sheaves of Lambda-modules over a Noetherian ring Lambda, here Lambda finite; equivalent for quasi-compact quasi-separated T to Definition Tag 03RW (label definition-constructible), which asks for such a partition on every affine open; finite locally constant as in Definition Tag 03RU. The global form is the constructibility clause of literature/blueprint/master/blueprint/sec-proper-base-change/sk-thm-p1/def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes.md
